summary: Tested Founder Access Request System - new request-based access flow (separate from invite links). All features working correctly: request submission, duplicate detection, admin approval with password, login verification, access revocation, and denial. Both access methods (invite links and access requests) coexist independently.
critical_code_review_comments: All new endpoints working correctly: POST /api/founder/requests, GET /api/founder/requests, POST /api/founder/requests/:id/approve, POST /api/founder/requests/:id/deny, POST /api/founder/requests/:id/revoke, POST /api/founder-about/login
Homepage 'Founder' button (data-testid='nav-founder-btn') opens frosted glass modal correctly
Request form has all required fields: name, email, message (optional)
Duplicate pending request correctly returns 'already_pending' status
Modal shows success/already_pending confirmation after submission
'Already have access? Sign in here' link navigates to /founder-about
/founder-about (no token) shows email + password login form
Login with wrong credentials shows appropriate error messages
Login with correct credentials shows the Founder page iframe
Login is reusable (can log in multiple times with same credentials)
After admin revokes access, login correctly fails
Admin Invites tab shows both sections: Invite Links and Access Requests
Admin can approve a request with a password (shows success toast)
Admin can deny and revoke requests
Existing invite link system still works independently (verified with 3 tests)
